# timescale_ip_allow_list (Resource)

An IP allow list for the project, optionally bound to services. Import using the numeric list ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "timescale_service" "db" {
  name = "my-service"
}

resource "timescale_ip_allow_list" "office" {
  description = "Office network"
  cidr_blocks = ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.7/32"]
  service_ids = [timescale_service.db.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr_blocks` (Set of String) IPv4 addresses or CIDR blocks allowed to connect, e.g. `203.0.113.7/32`. At least one entry is required. To delete the list, remove the resource from your configuration.
- `description` (String) A description of the IP allow list.

### Optional

- `service_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the services this list is bound to. If omitted, bindings are not managed by Terraform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the IP allow list.
